title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Donuts Original Glazed 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co.’s Seriously Donuts Original Glazed e-liquid focuses entirely on the warm, comforting taste of a classic freshly baked Donut, providing a smooth and rich foundation. The pastry notes are generously with the taste of a sweet, sticky Sugar syrup on the exhale, delivering a consistently satisfying and timeless dessert vape. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
